candidate.selection_reason: user-controlled property name -> embedded in property access code -> potential prototype pollution if not properly escaped
candidate.source_summary: Property name comes from node.index.getObjectProperty() which extracts value from ConstantNode dimensions in IndexNode. User input flows through expression parsing to create these nodes.
candidate.sink_summary: Property access via getSafeProperty function which validates object type and property ownership before access.
candidate.guard_summary: getSafeProperty enforces: 1) object must be plain object (isPlainObject check), 2) property must be own property (Object.hasOwnProperty check), 3) blocks access to constructor method, 4) uses safeMethods whitelist for function properties. Property name is stringified with escaping.
candidate.risk_pattern: User-controlled property names are validated through getSafeProperty's security controls before property access, preventing prototype pollution and unauthorized method access.
candidate.context_summary: Compiles object property access expressions to JavaScript code. When accessing object properties (not array indices), uses getSafeProperty wrapper for security validation.
unresolved_facts: Exact user input flow path from parser to AccessorNode creation
Whether all user input paths properly validate property names before reaching getSafeProperty

target_cwe.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
target_cwe.description: The product does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes user-controllable input before it is placed in output that is used as a web page that is served to other users.
remediation_steps: Use parameterized queries and prepared statements
Implement strict input validation with whitelisting

stage3_hypothesis.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
stage3_hypothesis.fit_reason: Prototype pollution via user-controlled property names could escalate to XSS if polluted properties affect output generation.
